channel.title: MiaoYan Blog
channel.description: Guides to writing in Markdown and keeping Markdown notes as local files on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

item.title: Choosing a Markdown editor for Mac
item.description: What to check in a Mac Markdown editor: plain files, WYSIWYG or split preview, math, sync and speed, with Typora, Obsidian, VS Code and MiaoYan compared.

item.title: Markdown cheat sheet: CommonMark, GFM and extensions
item.description: The Markdown syntax you actually use, with examples, what CommonMark and GFM each define, and what MiaoYan renders on top.

item.title: LaTeX math in Markdown: syntax, KaTeX and pitfalls
item.description: Write inline and block math in Markdown, use common LaTeX constructs, avoid dollar and underscore pitfalls, and see how MiaoYan renders KaTeX.

item.title: Mermaid diagrams in Markdown: flowchart, sequence, Gantt
item.description: Draw flowcharts, sequence and Gantt diagrams with fenced Mermaid blocks, plus PlantUML and Markmap, and what MiaoYan renders offline.

item.title: Markdown to slides: --- separators and MiaoYan PPT mode
item.description: Turn a Markdown note into a slide deck with --- separators, configure reveal.js options, and compare Marp, reveal.js and Slidev.

item.title: Markdown to PDF on Mac
item.description: Print a MiaoYan note to a fixed A4 PDF, and switch to Pandoc, Typora, VS Code, or the Mac print dialog for paper size and margins.

item.title: Typora alternative for Mac: split preview with MiaoYan
item.description: Why people leave Typora, WYSIWYG versus split preview, what carries over (files, math, images) and where each app is stronger.

item.title: Local-first Markdown notes: keep them as plain files
item.description: Why plain Markdown files in your own folder beat a locked-in notes app, what it costs, and how MiaoYan reads the folder you choose.

item.title: Sync Markdown notes across devices without a sync service
item.description: Use iCloud Drive, Nutstore, Dropbox or git to sync a Markdown notes folder, set MiaoYan's Note Location, and avoid conflict copies.

item.title: Wikilinks and backlinks in Markdown notes
item.description: How [[wikilinks]] differ from normal Markdown links, what MiaoYan supports, how backlinks are built, and the portability trade-offs.

item.title: Markdown notes from the terminal with the miao CLI
item.description: Install the miao CLI, learn open, new, search, list and cat, script them, and use them with AI coding agents and the MiaoYan skill.

item.title: A lighter Obsidian alternative for Mac
item.description: What MiaoYan has and leaves out compared with Obsidian, how to open a vault, and which syntax carries over.

item.title: Markdown note version history: MiaoYan, Time Machine, git
item.description: How MiaoYan saves and restores note versions, where they live, their limits, and how Time Machine and git cover what it does not.

item.title: Export Apple Notes as Markdown and open the files
item.description: macOS Tahoe can export a Notes note as Markdown. Sequoia exports PDF only. Check the file, then open it in MiaoYan.

item.title: A Bear alternative for Mac: plain Markdown files
item.description: Export Bear notes to Markdown, move them into folders MiaoYan reads, and see what you lose without tags and gain with plain files.

item.title: Chinese-English spacing in Markdown notes
item.description: Why Chinese writers add a space around Latin text and digits, the exceptions, and how MiaoYan's Clean Typography command applies it without touching code.

item.title: CommonMark vs GFM: which Markdown flavor to write
item.description: What CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown each define, what apps add on top, which layer MiaoYan renders, and a test file to check any editor.

item.title: Markdown code blocks: fences, language tags and nesting
item.description: Write fenced and inline code in Markdown, nest a fence inside a fence, tag languages and diff blocks, and see what MiaoYan's preview highlights.

item.title: Markdown collapsible sections with details and summary
item.description: Write a collapsible section in Markdown with details and summary, keep Markdown working inside it, and see how MiaoYan previews and exports it.

item.title: Markdown escape characters: backslash, entities and code spans
item.description: Which characters a Markdown backslash escapes, when you need it, entities and code spans as alternatives, and the dollar-sign trap in MiaoYan.

item.title: Markdown footnotes: syntax, support and fallbacks
item.description: Write [^1] footnotes and definitions, see where GitHub, Pandoc and MiaoYan V4.5.0 render them, and fix footnotes that show as plain text.

item.title: Markdown front matter: YAML, TOML and MiaoYan
item.description: Write YAML or TOML front matter for Hugo, Jekyll and Astro, see how GitHub shows it, and what MiaoYan V4.5.0 hides in preview and export.

item.title: Markdown images: syntax, size and broken paths
item.description: Insert images, set width with HTML, keep paths from breaking, and see how MiaoYan V4.5.0 stores, previews and exports images.

item.title: Markdown line breaks: soft, hard and MiaoYan's setting
item.description:
Why a single newline vanishes in Markdown, how backslash, two spaces and
differ, and what MiaoYan's Line Break setting changes in preview and export.

item.title: Markdown links and anchors: inline, reference, headings
item.description: Inline, reference and autolinks, spaces in URLs, heading anchors on GitHub, and how MiaoYan's preview handles fragments and relative links.

item.title: Markdown on iPad: files, sync and editors
item.description: What an iPad Markdown setup needs, how MiaoYan opens your Mac's iCloud Drive folder, what to check when a note is missing, and other editors.

item.title: Markdown tables: alignment, pipes and line breaks
item.description: Write a Markdown table, align columns, escape pipes, break lines in cells, handle wide tables in MiaoYan, and fall back to HTML for merged cells.

item.title: Markdown task lists and checkboxes: syntax and pitfalls
item.description: Write - [ ] and - [x] task lists, nest them, know where they render, how MiaoYan toggles a box in the source, and find open tasks with ripgrep.

item.title: Markmap mind maps from a Markdown outline
item.description: Turn headings and lists into a mind map with a markmap fence, what MiaoYan renders offline, which options apply, and how it differs from Mermaid.

item.title: PlantUML in Markdown: fences, server rendering and privacy
item.description: Write sequence, class and activity diagrams in a plantuml fence, how MiaoYan renders them with plantuml.com, the privacy cost, and local or Mermaid options.

item.title: What is Markdown? A plain-text way to format
item.description: What Markdown is, where it came from, the ten marks that cover most writing, how it becomes HTML, what it cannot do, and a first note in MiaoYan.
